title: 2024 Autumn Doctoral Degree Conferment Ceremony｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University

summary.lead: The third-year doctoral students of the 2024 academic year have graduated!

overview: The graduation and degree conferment ceremony for the third-year doctoral students of the 2024 academic year was held! Congratulations to all graduates! We wish you great success on your new path, building on the knowledge and experiences you gained at Ritsumeikan☺
